content.title: Online Image Noise Reducer
content.p1: Clean up grainy or speckled photos with our Image Noise Reducer. Using advanced median filtering, this tool removes random noise pixels while preserving the important edges and details of your image.
content.p2: This is perfect for fixing low-light photos, high-ISO grain, or scanning artifacts from old photographs.

clean.title: Remove Grain
clean.desc: Eliminate salt-and-pepper noise and random speckles.

smooth.title: Smooth Quality
smooth.desc: Create cleaner surfaces without blurring sharp edges like standard blur tools do.

levels.title: Adjustable Strength
levels.desc: Choose from multiple levels of noise reduction intensity.

how_to.title: How to Reduce Noise
list: Select a 'Denoise Strength' (Low is usually best for detail).

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: It uses a 'median filter' that looks at each pixel's neighbors and replaces outliers with the median value, effectively removing random noise dots.
faq.a2: High strength settings may smooth out fine textures, but it is much better at preserving edges than a simple blur.
